items.title: Bangladesh’s apparel exports to EU fall 11.9% to €13.48 billion in Jan-Sept
items.description: Steepest drop among top 11 suppliers as lower prices drive over half of the €1.82bn loss

items.title: 91% of firms upbeat on trade growth despite rising costs
items.description: Despite rising costs and trade uncertainty, 91 percent of Bangladeshi businesses remain confident about expanding their international trade over the next two years, according to a new HSBC survey.

items.title: Bring data and discipline to garment wage setting
items.description: The country needs a transparent and data-driven system to determine minimum wages for apparel workers, according to business leaders, labour experts and economists, as they say repeated reliance on bargaining and street protests is eroding

items.title: 15 banks account for 85% of default loans: BB
items.description: Only 15 banks -- including five recently merged shariah-based banks -- account for more than 85 percent of the over Tk 600,000 crore in non-performing loans (NPLs), underscoring that asset-quality distress remains concentrated in a handful

items.title: Govt eyes sovereign bond debut, IMF deal within 3 months
items.description: Bangladesh plans to issue its first sovereign bond and reach a deal with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) within three months as it seeks to diversify its financing sources, senior government officials said yesterday.

items.title: Tea estate owners seek Tk 2,500cr low-interest lifeline
items.description: Tea estate owners and planters have sought a Tk 2,000 crore to Tk 2,500 crore low-interest fund from Bangladesh Bank to revive the sector, along with easier terms for loan rescheduling, central bank officials said.

items.title: Beximco Pharma plans subsidiary to diversify products
items.description: Beximco Pharmaceuticals PLC plans to set up a wholly owned subsidiary to manufacture and market herbal medicinal products, as the drug maker seeks to diversify its product portfolio and expand its presence in the healthcare market.
